Definition: contracted for G1438; self (in some oblique case or reflexive relation):--her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.
BiblicalUsage: Hautou is the shortened form of the word for self, himself or itself, and it appears wherever the New Testament speaks of what someone does by himself. In Hebrews 1:3 Christ by himself purged our sins, in John 2:24 Jesus did not commit himself unto men, and in Ephesians 2:15 he made in himself one new man out of two.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little word carries the gospel: he did it by himself, because no one else could, and the one new man is made in himself, not in me.
